title: leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean Leucanthemopsis, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. pyrenaica are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic potential.
